WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year,
           31 AS first_week, 34 AS last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, 
           f.product_key, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.product_key, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
period_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = n.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM period_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN period_sales ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.category;

-- Verify total net sales for P8 FY2025/26 and P8 FY2024/25 from rpt_daily_store_sales
SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(net_sales) as total_net_sales
FROM (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, COALESCE(SUM(rds.net_sales), 0) as net_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
    RIGHT JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = rds.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 31 AND 34
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC;

-- Verify that my query correctly identifies Garden and Electrical products
SELECT DISTINCT cp.category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) as sku_count
FROM dim_product p
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY cp.category
ORDER BY cp.category;

-- Verify the breakdown of sales and returns for Garden and Electrical in P8
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_detail AS (
    SELECT 'Sales' as type, d.fiscal_year, cp.category, 
           COUNT(*) as line_count, SUM(f.net_amount) as net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 31 AND 34
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cp.category
),
returns_detail AS (
    SELECT 'Returns' as type, d.fiscal_year, cp.category, 
           COUNT(*) as line_count, SUM(-r.refund_net) as net_amount
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 31 AND 34
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cp.category
)
SELECT type, fiscal_year, category, line_count, ROUND(net_amount, 2) as net_amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM sales_detail UNION ALL SELECT * FROM returns_detail)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, category, type;
